warmup: No extra warm-up replay; each fresh process prepares its own features before timing replay.
scope: Already-parsed bars and selected configurations through features, layout, state setup, replay, ordered summary construction. CSV reads/writes, validation and configuration enumeration are outside the timed whole interval.
selection: Nested lexicographic prefixes of fast<slow pairs. All 48 windows are referenced at every selected K. Configuration populations change with K; this is part of the stated workload.
interpretation: Pilot scale and variation only. Synthetic financial outputs have no historical-return interpretation. Freeze a main plan separately after inspecting this pilot.
